description: Adds 28 or 39 Clear Gem checks, depending on sapphire_relics (as some require warp 6 access).
Clear Gem items are only created as-needed as filler items, as they aren't useful logically.
Adds 10 or 14 Colored Gem checks and 4 or 5 Colored Gem items, depending on sapphire_relics (as Yellow Gem require warp 6 access).
Adds 5 warp room unlock items (e.g. Warp 1 Unlock) for warp rooms 1-5. You will start with 1 random one.
This features requires using emulator cheats (see https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Crash-3-Manual-2-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ).
If disabled, vanilla game logic is used (warp rooms unlock in multiples of 5 Crystal checks + 5 Crystal items received).
Adds 31 or 35 level unlock items (e.g. Toad Village Unlock), depending on sapphire_relics (as some require warp 6 access).
You will start with 2 random ones (1 will be guaranteed to be in your starting warp room).
Levels which have a secret or second entrance (such as Hang'em High's warp 6 entrance) only have 1 level unlock item which allows for both.
If disabled, levels are logically accessible immediately upon having warp room access.
Adds 30 Sapphire Relic checks and items. This option is required to logically add warp 6. Doing so has the following effects:
- Adds the Yellow Gem item and its associated check via Hang'em High's warp 6 entrance.
- Adds 11 Clear Gem checks which require warp 6 access, if clear_gem_checks is enabled.
- Adds level unlock items for Ski Crazed, Area 51?, Rings of Power, and Eggipus Rex, if level_unlock_items is enabled.
Sapphire Relic checks have no logical requirements besides level access, due to being trivial to do without Running Shoes.
If disabled, warp 6 and anything requiring it will not be added, and no Sapphire Relic checks and items will be added.
Adds Gold Relic checks (no items), with 2 choices for their logic.
All 30 will be added if sapphire_relics is enabled, otherwise only 26 (leaving out Ski Crazed, Area 51?, Rings of Power, and Eggipus Rex) will be added.
off: No Gold Relic checks will be added.
on_casual: Gold Relic checks in Crash platforming levels will logically require Running Shoes. All others (i.e. in Coco and vehicle levels) have no logical requirements.
- Running Shoes will be marked as progression, instead of useful, if this is chosen.
- See https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Crash-3-Manual-2-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ for info on how to enable all abilities early.
on_speedrun: All Gold Relic checks will have no logical requirements. Broadly speaking, this is not hard for most levels, but speedrun tech (such as neutral slide jumps) can trivialize these.
Adds Platinum Relic checks (no items), with 2 choices for their logic.
All 30 will be added if sapphire_relics is enabled, otherwise only 26 (leaving out Ski Crazed, Area 51?, Rings of Power, and Eggipus Rex) will be added.
off: No Platinum Relic checks will be added.
on_casual: Platinum Relic checks in Crash platforming levels will logically require Running Shoes. All others (i.e. in Coco and vehicle levels) have no logical requirements.
- Running Shoes will be marked as progression, instead of useful, if this is chosen.
- See https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Crash-3-Manual-2-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ for info on how to enable all abilities early.

on_speedrun: All Platinum Relic checks will have no logical requirements. This is much harder to do than Gold Relic checks without Running Shoes, but still possible, especially with speedrun tech (such as neutral slide jumps).
Controls how many Crystal items you must receive to goal, if "Crystal Goal" is selected.
Decides how many colored (Blue, Green, Purple, Red, Yellow) Gem items  you must receive to goal, if "Colored Gem Goal" is selected.
Maximum is 4 if sapphire_relics is disabled, due to Yellow Gem requiring warp 6 access.
Decides how many Sapphire Relic checks you must complete to goal, if "Sapphire Relic Goal" is selected.
Decides how many Gold Relic checks you must complete to goal, if "Gold Relic Goal" is selected.
Maximum is 26 if sapphire_relics is disabled, due to Ski Crazed, Area 51?, Rings of Power, and Eggipus Rex requiring warp 6 access.
Controls how many Platinum Relic checks you must complete to goal, if "Platinum Relic Goal" is selected.
Maximum is 26 if sapphire_relics is disabled, due to Ski Crazed, Area 51?, Rings of Power, and Eggipus Rex requiring warp 6 access.
